scope: independent segment screening; not lap times or engineering certification

notes: All material, soil, vehicle, weather, wear and drainage values are illustrative assumptions, not measurements or design values.
Bayinbuluke is a fictional film course; only the reported fictional scale (109 km, 1462 bends) is borrowed.
Pikes Peak borrows only published race scale (12.42 miles, 156 bends); its generated radii, grades and width are not surveyed geometry.
Rainfall and saturation are independent imposed inputs; this is not an infiltration or rainfall-runoff time-series solver.
Each segment is tested independently at fixed speed; infeasible demand is flagged, not integrated into a trajectory or lap time.
The protected routing fraction assumes a functioning protected outlet; it does not make water disappear or certify downstream safety.
Wear is a pass-count sensitivity assumption. The model does not simulate mat tearing, displaced fragments, ruts or vehicle rollover.
